## Study approach
Section 3.2 and Table 1. Why $\mathrm{softmax}(QK^\top/\sqrt{d_k})V$ stops variance growing with $d_k$; $O(1)$ max path length.

## Interview hooks
**Must master (rapid-fire):** parameter count for d_model=1024, 16 heads, 24 layers, 50K vocab; why FFN expands to 4×d_model; pre-norm vs post-norm gradient flow; LayerNorm vs RMSNorm; ReLU → GeLU → SwiGLU; why modern models drop dropout; what individual heads learn; sinusoidal vs learned vs RoPE vs ALiBi ([RoPE paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.09864), [ALiBi paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.12409)) and why absolute encodings fail past training length.

## Break-it experiments
1. **HAND** — Remove `/ math.sqrt(d_k)` at d_k=512, feed random normal Q, K, inspect `Q.grad` — softmax goes one-hot and gradients vanish.
   - Code: `experiments/exp1_remove_at_d_k_512_feed_random_no.ipynb`
2. **HAND** — Change −inf to 0 in the causal mask; val loss collapses to ~0 while generation is garbage.
   - Code: `experiments/exp2_change_inf_to_0_in_the_causal_ma.ipynb`

This is the single most-asked implementation; the full decoder block is Phase 2 row 3.
